comment: Metric-view base for the credit watchlist (mv_watchlist, D13): a record_type union of Event rows (one per watchlist register event: Added, Escalated, De-escalated, Removed, with reason, owner RM and the action plan status at 30-Sep-2026) and Month-End Membership rows (one per client on the watchlist at each month-end from Apr-2024: final EWS band, days on the list, drawn exposure, EAD and ECL at that month-end). Event measures (Added, Removed, Actions Overdue) are populated only on Event rows; membership measures (Watchlist Clients, Watchlist Exposure USD, ECL on Watchlist USD) only on Membership rows - these are point-in-time: take the latest month-end (window semiadditive last), never sum across months. Grain: one row per record_type x record (watchlist event, or client x month-end on the watchlist).
